name: ranram Visual Grammar

structure.role: structural outlines and bold line weights

accent_orange.role: circulation paths, highlight zones, programme fills

accent_yellow.role: secondary accent — sun, energy, or programme colour

structural_outline.role: primary building envelope and major structural elements

interior_partition.role: internal walls, floor plates, programme dividers

diagram_types.name: axonometric_section
diagram_types.description: Cutaway axonometric revealing interior organisation and structure
diagram_types.typical_use: Showing spatial relationships, programme stacking, structural logic

diagram_types.name: exploded_axonometric
diagram_types.description: Components separated along a vertical axis to show assembly logic
diagram_types.typical_use: Construction sequence, layer separation, material systems

diagram_types.name: bubble_concept_diagram
diagram_types.description: Soft circular or organic shapes showing programme adjacencies and flow
diagram_types.typical_use: Early concept stage, functional zoning, stakeholder communication

diagram_types.name: site_plan_aerial
diagram_types.description: Top-down orthographic view of building and context at urban or site scale
diagram_types.typical_use: Urban context, site strategy, landscape integration

diagram_types.name: narrative_process_diagram
diagram_types.description: Sequential panels or flow arrows showing a design or social process over time

diagram_types.name: programme_stack_diagram
diagram_types.description: Stacked horizontal bands colour-coded by programme type with labels
diagram_types.typical_use: Vertical programme distribution in towers or mixed-use buildings

diagram_types.name: facade_diagram
diagram_types.description: Elevation with annotated layers showing facade system, apertures, and solar strategy
diagram_types.typical_use: Building skin performance, facade articulation, glazing ratios

diagram_types.name: environmental_diagram
diagram_types.description: Arrows and gradient fills showing sun, wind, water, or energy flows
diagram_types.typical_use: Passive design strategies, environmental performance, climate response

human_figures.detail: none — no facial features, no clothing detail
human_figures.note: Always include at least one figure to establish human scale. Groups of 2-4 preferred.

primary.use: Zone labels, programme names, key headings

typography.rule: No serif fonts anywhere in ranram diagrams

signature_elements: programme colour coding with orange as primary accent
human scale always shown — never scaleless
bold graphic contrast — no gradients or shadows
deliberate white space — negative space is design
orange accent for circulation or highlight zones
annotation leaders with short text blocks
bold enclosing shapes for programme zones

figure_tokens: flat black human silhouettes for scale
